info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Term Deposit Details API
info.description: The Term Deposit Details API provides access to specific information about term deposits. It allows users to retrieve detailed data for a particular term deposit identified by a unique parameter. This API is beneficial for banking applications and financial services that require transparency and detailed insights into term deposit accounts. Typical consumers include financial analysts, banking software developers, and application users seeking comprehensive data about their term deposits.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a specific term deposit.
get.description: Fetch the detailed information for the term deposit identified by RES-100045. This operation provides the required data to assess the deposit's terms, interest rates, and other relevant information.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving term deposit details by ID. It is essential to specify the appropriate parameters in the JSON format based on the schema provided.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the term deposit details.
